_note: Universal (fault-agnostic) strings. DEC-088 compliant. 'warranty' appears only in the warranty_ui block, which IS the contractor-controlled field DEC-088 permits. Board-reviewed 2026-06-18: replacement service line now names the action + 'full factory coverage' for homeowner clarity (avoids unqualified warranty promise).

replacement_components.equipment: New high-efficiency HVAC system, matched to your home's load
replacement_components.refrigerant: Factory refrigerant charge, set to manufacturer spec
replacement_components.installation: Professional installation, including electrical and refrigerant line connections
replacement_components.service: Old unit removal and haul-away, permit, and registration of the new system with the manufacturer

footers.cost_transparency: This estimate covers parts, labor, and the service items listed for each option. Ask your contractor about anything not shown here.
footers.estimate_validity: This is a written estimate based on the diagnosed condition. The final price may change if on-site work uncovers conditions different from those assessed.

warranty_ui.helper_text: If filled in, this appears on the homeowner report under your name. Leave blank to omit any warranty mention.
warranty_ui.validation_error: Warranty terms must be 500 characters or fewer.
warranty_ui.default_behavior: Leave blank to omit warranty terms from the homeowner report.
